remarks: Beach Living Awaits at 33 Burnham Hill Road, Westport. Build or reimagine the home of your dreams on this generous .61-acre lot (approximately 100' x 266'), perfectly positioned on a peaceful cul-de-sac in Compo Beach. The property features a beautiful stone wall, an expansive yard, and is surrounded by homes of substantial size. With ample room for a pool, it presents endless opportunities for outdoor enjoyment and design flexibility. This rare offering combines privacy, community, and coastal charm - all just moments from Westport's sandy shoreline, Longshore Club Park, and the vibrant downtown scene. Imagine mornings with ocean breezes, afternoon walks to the beach, and evenings watching the sunset over Long Island Sound. From a modern beach retreat to a charming New England escape, the possibilities here are as inspiring as the setting itself. Enjoy all that Westport has to offer - schools, fine dining, shopping, recreation, and an easy commute to NYC - from one of the town's most beautiful neighborhoods. 33 Burnham Hill: Where your coastal dream begins.
